title: Rebooking Context and the Crestline Companion Phone Booking Fee
content:
**Rule.** On Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, how the phone booking fee of a call-center booking is worked out follows the most recent trip reinstatement on the certificate or pass and the calendar days from its entry date to the entry date of the most recent companion booking, the reinstatement date excluded and the booking date included:

| Most recent trip reinstatement | Days from its entry date to the booking's entry date | Phone booking fee |
|---|---|---|
| on the ground of a cancellation Crestline made | 90 or fewer | the product's phone booking fee multiplied by 0.5, rounded half up to the cent |
| on the ground of a voluntary cancellation | 90 or fewer | the product's phone booking fee plus a rebooking handling amount of 10 USD |
| either ground | more than 90 | the product's phone booking fee |
| no reinstatement on the product | — | the product's phone booking fee |

## Hypothetical cases (product's phone booking fee of 25 USD)

- Reinstatement after a Crestline cancellation on 1 February 2025, new booking entered 2 May 2025 (90 days): 12.50 USD.
- Same reinstatement, booking entered 3 May 2025 (91 days): 25.00 USD.
- Reinstatement after a voluntary cancellation on 10 March, booking entered 20 March (10 days): 35.00 USD.
- No reinstatement ever recorded on the pass: 25.00 USD.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
